# FamilyBridge

> Recovery support and family coordination for people affected by addiction.

FamilyBridge helps people in recovery, families, and authorized professionals coordinate communication, boundaries, shared actions, decisions, and follow-through. FamilyBridge is a support platform, not a medical, mental health, treatment, emergency, or crisis service.

## Primary public pages

- [Homepage](https://familybridgeapp.com/): Family recovery support and coordination overview.
- [Family plan](https://familybridgeapp.com/family-purchase): Family plan details and signup.
- [For treatment providers](https://familybridgeapp.com/for-providers): Privacy-conscious collaboration with authorized providers.
- [Provider plan](https://familybridgeapp.com/provider-purchase): Provider plan details.
- [Product demo](https://familybridgeapp.com/demo): Overview of the demonstration experience.
- [Recovery meeting check-ins](https://familybridgeapp.com/meetings): Meeting-finder and check-in tools.
- [Enabling exercise](https://familybridgeapp.com/enabling-exercise): Guided reflection on support, boundaries, and enabling patterns.
- [Support](https://familybridgeapp.com/support): Help and contact information.
- [Privacy policy](https://familybridgeapp.com/privacy): FamilyBridge privacy practices.
- [Terms of service](https://familybridgeapp.com/terms): Terms governing use of FamilyBridge.

## Important limitations

FamilyBridge does not diagnose, treat, prescribe, guarantee recovery, forecast readiness, or predict an individual's outcome. AI-assisted features organize authorized information and suggest items for human review. Professional access is limited by explicit authorization and does not expose private family or clinical information broadly.

For immediate danger in the United States, call 911. For a mental health or suicide crisis, call or text 988.

## About

FamilyBridge was founded by Matt Brown, an addiction interventionist with more than 20 years of experience and long-term personal recovery.
